subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: June 15, 2022 at 9:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
